profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at ConnectiveRx  · C# · MuleSoft · AWS · Integrations & APIs
profile.summary:
I build integration platforms and backend heavy systems that stay up, behave predictably, and don't become painful to change six months later. Over the last 9+ years, most of my work has been in C#, MuleSoft, and AWS, with some React and Angular when the job calls for it.

At ConnectiveRx, I led the development of an API led and file based integrations platform that replaced a set of ad hoc flows and cut new client setup time in half. I also designed a retry mechanism that eliminated message loss (from 7% to 0%) across, network, connectivity, and systemic failures in enterprise workflows. Along the way, I’ve mentored junior developers through client implementations, partnered closely with QA teams, and stepped into production issues to diagnose and resolve problems quickly.

Before that, I worked on ASP.NET and SQL Server systems for mortgage and logistics clients, migrating 10+ legacy applications to MVC and improving performance by roughly 30%. That experience is why I focus on observability, clear integration contracts, and building platforms that other teams actually want to work with.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Led an API led integration platform (MuleSoft, DataWeave and AWS services), integrating with Salesforce, cutting new client setup time by 50%.
- Built a reusable, file based exchange platform, replacing ad-hoc integrations.
- Designed and implemented an intelligent retry mechanism, reducing message loss from 7% to 0% across connectivity, network, and systemic failures in enterprise processes.
- Led 2 junior developers through client implementations (shadowing, peer reviews, and day to day guidance), and collaborated with QA on testing for every other release.
- Owned production support calls, troubleshooting issues and maintaining platform SLAs and stability.
- Contributed to design sessions led by fellow seniors, providing input and recommendations even on projects outside my direct ownership.
- Drove AI assisted modernization of services (Java8 to Java17), enabling safer and faster migrations of high availability systems.
- Owned maintenance and enhancement of MVC applications (C#/React/Angular/SQL Server), improving reliability and user experience for internal operations teams and external stakeholders.
positions.insights: MuleSoft CloudHub, MuleSoft Anypoint Platform and +3 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Built and maintained application modules for Radian Group using ASP.NET MVC, C#, Entity Framework, JavaScript, HTML, and SQL Server to support core mortgage and insurance business workflows.
- Optimized Entity Framework queries and SQL stored procedures, reducing average response times by 30% for customer facing operations.
- Collaborated with cross functional teams (QA, BA, product) to deliver enhancements and fixes on schedule, helping maintain high availability and reliability for production systems.

positions.title: App Developer
positions.description:
- Migrated 10+ legacy applications to a more modern ASP.NET MVC architecture using C#, Entity Framework, Bootstrap, and jQuery, supporting key clients like Danone and Bonafont in their logistics and supply chain operations.
- Developed and maintained WCF services and web applications, delivering client specific requirements that improved operational workflows and reduced deployment times by 30%.
- Collaborated on enhancements with senior engineers and QA, helping ensure reliable performance for logistics and supply chain applications in production.
